basic_details.job_title: SAIL BSL GDMO Consultant Recruitment 2026 - Walk in
basic_details.organization_name: Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL), Bokaro Steel Plant
basic_details.application_mode: Offline (at the time of Walk-in Interview)
basic_details.short_information: The Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL), Bokaro Steel Plant, has released an official notification (Advt. No. BSL/R-C/2026-07 dated 23.07.2026) inviting applications from qualified doctors, including retired doctors, for engagement as Consultant General Duty Medical Officers (GDMO) for the Jharkhand Group of Mines, SAIL. Eligible candidates can appear directly in a Walk-in Interview scheduled for 12.08.2026. This article covers all official details including vacancy, eligibility, age limit, salary, selection process, and how to apply.

qualification.details: Interested and eligible candidates with the requisite qualifications can walk in for the interview at the scheduled date, time, and venue. Ex-employees of SAIL Plants/Units and other PSUs/Government organizations can also apply, provided they have not separated from service by opting for voluntary retirement. Such ex-employee doctors must submit a self-certificate confirming this. Candidates must be Indian nationals possessing the requisite qualification from an institute recognized by MCI/NMC/SMC (as applicable), along with a valid practitioner licence.

salary_details.details: Company accommodation may be provided on payment/availability basis to ex-SAIL employees (subject to entitlement) and to non-SAIL employees (2 BHK or equivalent category), as per applicable rent and utility charges. No House Rent Allowance (HRA) is admissible. Post-paid SIM under CUG, including monthly call charges and rental, is provided with a monthly ceiling of ₹350/- for MBBS-qualified consultants. Medical benefits for self and spouse are available at the unit hospital, subject to conditions; ex-SAIL employees continue to receive benefits as applicable to them. 10 days of leave per year is admissible, subject to prior approval. Maternity leave is admissible as per the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961, subject to fulfilment of stipulated conditions. | The initial tenure of engagement is one year, or till the consultant attains the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier. The tenure can be further extended by one year at the discretion of the company. The maximum period of engagement under the same contract will not exceed 3 years; however, there is no bar on re-engagement, subject to the prescribed upper age limit. Performance will be reviewed annually, and the tenure may be curtailed or extended based on performance.

selection_process: Selection will be through a Walk-in Interview followed by a medical screening. Engagement will begin immediately after the selection process is completed and orders for engagement are issued. Candidates must download and submit the Application Form (Annexure-I) along with all supporting documents at the time of the Walk-in Interview. No other mode of application will be accepted.
how_to_apply: SAIL Bokaro Steel Plant has not provided an online application mode for this recruitment. Candidates must follow the offline process below:
Download the Application Form (Annexure-I) from the official notification.
Fill in the application form in capital letters with accurate personal, educational, and professional details.
Affix a recent passport-size colour photograph as specified in the form.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents along with the original documents.
Report at the interview venue on 12.08.2026 between 9:30 AM and 2:00 PM for registration.
Submit the duly filled application form along with supporting documents at the time of the Walk-in Interview.
Note: No other mode of application will be accepted apart from submission at the Walk-in Interview.
important_instructions: All certificates and documents in support of eligibility will be verified only at the time of the Walk-in Interview. Candidates who fail to produce the required documents will not be allowed to appear for the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Walk-in Interview or the selection process. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis and does not confer any right to regular appointment in SAIL, BSL, in any manner. The contractual engagement can be terminated by either party by giving one month's notice. It can also be terminated by the company in cases of poor performance, moral turpitude, conviction by a Court of Law, insolvency, loss of licence to practice, grave misconduct, financial irregularity, or medical unfitness that prevents the consultant from discharging normal duty hours. SAIL, BSL reserves the right to reject any application, cancel candidature, cancel the interview process, or engage fewer consultants than indicated, without assigning any reason. Candidature is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found false or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria. The Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Bokaro Steel City, Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under SAIL Bokaro GDMO Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are announced for the post of Consultant GDMO (UR-2, OBC-1).

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification required for SAIL Bokaro GDMO Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MBBS degree from a University/Institute recognized by MCI/NMC/SMC and be registered with MCI/NMC/SMC or hold a valid practitioner license.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for SAIL Bokaro GDMO Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 69 years as on the date of advertisement, i.e., 23.07.2026. Candidates must be medically fit to perform their duties.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for SAIL Bokaro GDMO Consultant post?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration for MBBS-qualified Consultant GDMOs is ₹1,00,000/- per month.

faq.answer: There is no online application mode. Candidates must download the Application Form (Annexure-I), fill it, and submit it along with supporting documents directly at the Walk-in Interview.
